intro: Over the past month, ZCyberNews has tracked 11 articles tagged healthcare, with 10 rated high severity. The threat actors Interlock, LockBit, and Rhysida were observed targeting the healthcare, Healthcare, critical infrastructure, Government, and pharmaceutical sectors globally, including the United States, Illinois, Moldova, and the Netherlands. The articles span from April 12 to May 12, 2026, with one medium-severity report among the coverage.
